Major Location.definition: Broad region of the dominant hand relative to the body.

label_hints.Arm: dominant hand is mainly on or near the arm
label_hints.Body: dominant hand is mainly near torso/body
label_hints.Hand: dominant hand is mainly on or near the nondominant hand
label_hints.Head: dominant hand is mainly near head/face
label_hints.Neutral: dominant hand is mainly in neutral signing space

Minor Location.definition: Specific sub-region where the dominant hand is articulated, contacts, starts, or is closest.

label_hints.Arm Away: near the arm but away from direct contact
label_hints.Body Away: near the torso/body but away from direct contact
label_hints.Cheek Nose: near the cheek or nose area of the face
label_hints.Elbow Back: on/near the back side of the elbow
label_hints.Eye: at or near the eye region
label_hints.Finger Back: on/near the back/dorsal side of the fingers
label_hints.Finger Front: on/near the front/palm side of the fingers
label_hints.Finger Radial: on/near the thumb-side/radial edge of the fingers
label_hints.Finger Ulnar: on/near the pinky-side/ulnar edge of the fingers
label_hints.Forearm Back: on/near the back/dorsal side of the forearm
label_hints.Forearm Front: on/near the front/inner side of the forearm
label_hints.Forearm Ulnar: on/near the pinky-side/ulnar edge of the forearm
label_hints.Hand Away: near the nondominant hand but away from direct contact
label_hints.Head Away: near the head/face but away from direct contact
label_hints.Head Top: at or near the top of the head
label_hints.Heel: at or near the heel/base of the palm
label_hints.Neutral: in neutral signing space rather than a specific body subpart
label_hints.Other: a specific location not covered by the listed labels
label_hints.Palm: on/near the palm of the nondominant hand
label_hints.Palm Back: on/near the back/dorsal side of the hand
label_hints.Torso Bottom: at or near the lower torso
label_hints.Torso Mid: at or near the middle torso
label_hints.Torso Top: at or near the upper torso/chest
label_hints.Upper Lip: at or near the upper lip
label_hints.Wrist Back: on/near the back/dorsal side of the wrist
label_hints.Wrist Front: on/near the front/palm side of the wrist

Contact.definition: Whether the active hand contacts the body or the other hand during the sign.

Selected Fingers.definition: The fingers that are phonologically selected in the dominant handshape.

label_hints.imp: selected fingers are: index, middle, pinky/little finger
label_hints.imr: selected fingers are: index, middle, ring
label_hints.imrp: selected fingers are: index, middle, ring, pinky/little finger
label_hints.ip: selected fingers are: index, pinky/little finger
label_hints.mrp: selected fingers are: middle, ring, pinky/little finger

Flexion.definition: Degree or pattern of bending/closure of the selected fingers.

label_hints.Bent: selected fingers bend sharply at a joint
label_hints.Flat: selected fingers are straight/flat at the visible joints
label_hints.Fully Closed: selected fingers are closed into the palm

Flexion Change.definition: Whether finger flexion changes during the sign.

Spread.definition: Whether selected fingers are spread apart rather than held together.

Spread Change.definition: Whether finger spread changes during the sign.

label_hints.1: finger spread changes during the sign

Thumb Position.definition: Whether the thumb is open/extended or closed/adducted in the handshape.

label_hints.Closed: thumb is closed/tucked against the palm or fingers
label_hints.Open: thumb is extended/open away from the palm or fingers

Thumb Contact.definition: Whether the thumb contacts another finger or part of the hand in the handshape.

Sign Type.definition: One-handed/two-handed organization and symmetry/dominance relation between hands.

label_hints.Asymmetrical Different Handshape: both hands are used with different handshapes
label_hints.Asymmetrical Same Handshape: both hands have same handshape but different roles/movement
label_hints.Dominance Violation: two-handed sign violates the dominance condition
label_hints.One Handed: only the dominant hand is active
label_hints.Symmetrical Or Alternating: both hands share the same/related handshape and move symmetrically or alternately
label_hints.Symmetry Violation: two-handed sign violates the symmetry condition

Path Movement.definition: Trajectory of the hand through signing space.

label_hints.Back And Forth: dominant hand moves back and forth
label_hints.Circular: dominant hand moves in a circular path
label_hints.Curved: dominant hand moves along a curved path
label_hints.Other: path is present but not one of the listed shapes
label_hints.Straight: dominant hand moves along a straight path

Wrist Twist.definition: Whether the wrist rotates/twists during the sign.
